description: Search ONE city on the user's account and get the businesses back in the same call: 1 to 5 result pages from the city centre, about 20 per page. Use it when the user asks for a quick search, a page of results or one town; for a whole city or several, use search_areas, which finds several times more. Costs 1 token per NEW business (one new lead costs one token); ones the account already holds are free. Every new business is then enriched from its own website in the background, about two minutes for 20: business email with its verification state, a named contact where the site names one, the software it runs, and a check that it really is the kind of business searched for. Returns the Maps listing and a search_id. Then call list_results with that search_id and wait_seconds 40, and show the user what enrichment found, not only the listing.

pages.description: Result pages to pull, 1-5 (about 20 results per page). Default 1.

query.description: Business keyword, e.g. "roofing contractor" or "cosmetic dentist" (max 200 chars)

name: search_leads
title: Quick one-city search
